 Order

The Writ Petition has been filed in the nature of a Mandamus seeking a direction to the first respondent to pay fair compensation in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, for acquiring the land of the petitioner for constructing railway https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis flyover at Thirupparankundram, in Survey No.184/2A.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioner had given a representation on 09.02.2023.

2. A counter affidavit had been filed by the second respondent, wherein, it had been stated that compensation had been determined at Rs.2,102/- per square meter and the petitioner has expressed his willingness to receive the said compensation.

3. But however, when the petitioner has now sought re- visitation of the amount of the compensation granted and had given an application which is admitted, it is obligatory on the part of the second respondent to issue notice to the petitioner herein and thereafter, examine whether the petitioner is entitled for enhancement of compensation.
The petitioner may place before the second respondent all necessary documents.

4. It is also complained by the learned counsel for petitioner that the demolition charges had also been deducted from the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis compensation amount from the petitioner herein.

It is stated that after acquisition, the petitioner is left with only 120 square meters of lands /
building.
Let these aspects be examined by the second respondent once again on the basis of the representation given by the petitioner herein.
The second respondent may therefore, issue notice to the petitioner, examine the representation of the petitioner and pass necessary orders.
The entire exercise must be completed within a period of eight (8) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
